title: Riverside Library Network: Annual Review 2025
key_sentences: The Riverside Library Network operates five branches across the eastern districts.
Membership grew steadily throughout the year, with the strongest gains among students.
The network also completed the move of its archive to a climate-controlled store.
The Canal Street branch recorded the largest increase after its refurbishment.
Weekly homework clubs ran in every branch during term time.
The digital skills course for older readers was fully booked within days.
The board plans to open a sixth branch in the harbour quarter in 2027.
Until then, the mobile library will serve the harbour quarter twice a week.
